maintenance.why: Fine dust coats the intake over time. A dry brush keeps airflow high.
Lithium cells dislike deep discharge and heat. Never leave the unit in a parked car in summer.
A washable foam or mesh filter clogs with fine dust. Dry it fully before refitting.
A full bin chokes airflow and drops the real suction well below the rating.

maintenance.task: Check seals and the bin latch
maintenance.why: A loose seal leaks dust back out. Press the bin and listen for a rattle.

faq.a: USB-C is easier because any phone charger works, as with the LYFUHUI 13000Pa Handheld if listed. A proprietary jack is one more item to lose. Check the listing.

faq.q: Are cheap mini vacuums worth buying?
faq.a: For crumbs and light dust, yes, but expect weaker battery management, filters that clog fast and motor bearing noise by year one to two. The yoyoto 23000Pa Handheld and the LYFUHUI 13000Pa Handheld show the trade. Do not buy cheap for sand or heavy pet hair.

faq.q: Is it safe to leave one in the car?
faq.a: Avoid it, since a parked car in summer gets hot enough to damage lithium cells. Take the yoyoto 23000Pa Handheld inside or keep it in a shaded compartment. Do not charge on a bed or sofa.

faq.q: What nozzle do I need for pet hair?
faq.a: A brush or rubber nozzle, because suction alone rarely lifts embedded hair. The yoyoto 23000Pa Handheld and LYFUHUI 13000Pa Handheld have different kits. Pet households should count the tools.

faq.q: How long will the battery really last?
faq.a: Plan on 10 to 15 minutes in boost and roughly double that in eco mode. The yoyoto 23000Pa Handheld and similar units quote their best-case figure. Cheap cells fade after a year or two.

faq.q: How often should I wash the filter?
faq.a: About monthly with regular use, and let it dry fully. The yoyoto 23000Pa Handheld and other washable filters last longer this way. Replace it when airflow drops.
